method: Owner-directed rework (2026-08-23): natural/organic weakening, all bands measured 2026-08-23. Bands 1600-2200 serve Stockfish's native UCI_LimitStrength at the label and are anchored BY CONSTRUCTION - these exact settings at 400ms/move are the anchors the v1 gate scale was defined on (data/calibration/ruler-checks.txt: 1600/1800/2000/2200 labels mutually consistent). 1400/1200 keep the limiter's native error model and throttle NODES (hardware-independent in browsers; measured DIRECT vs SF@1320@400ms, 100g each). The 1400 LABEL is defective at 400ms (~1243) and the uciElo knob saturates above it (1450->1480, 1500->1497 at movetime) - 1400 ships uciElo 1450 + nodes 30000 (probes: 1430@400ms and 1450@30k both 1409+-144; the node config is hardware-independent). 1000/800/600 are ORGANIC (selectOrganicMove: ONE depth-1 MultiPV search, softmax at temperature; no blunder branch, no random floor) and are measured CHAINED down the ladder (150g each vs the next band up - direct-vs-SF@1320 scores are too extreme below ~1100, e.g. t9 scored 8.5% giving +-122): ci95 quotes match (+) anchor in quadrature. Organic knob map (measured): temperature saturates toward uniform-over-lines (~920 ceiling-floor at mpv8); MultiPV is the sub-900 knob (d1 t12: mpv8~920, mpv10~754, mpv11~619(40g)/678(150g), mpv13:t14=594). Regenerate only via scripts/arena.mts + scripts/fit-organic.mts --finalize; never hand-edit measured fields.
